items.quote: And the LORD spake unto Moses after the death of the two sons of Aaron, when they offered before the LORD, and died;
items.claim: The text says the LORD spoke to Moses after Aaron's two sons died when they made an offering before the LORD.
items.mechanism: divine speech following the deaths of Aaron's two sons during an offering

items.quote: Speak unto Aaron thy brother, that he come not at all times into the holy place within the vail before the mercy seat, which is upon the ark; that he die not:
items.claim: Moses is told to instruct Aaron not to enter the holy place behind the veil, before the mercy seat on the ark, at any time he chooses, so that he does not die.
items.action: come not at all times into
items.object: the holy place within the vail before the mercy seat
items.place: holy place within the vail, before the mercy seat upon the ark
items.mechanism: access is restricted, and breaking the restriction is tied to death

items.quote: for I will appear in the cloud upon the mercy seat.
items.claim: The reason given for the restriction is that the LORD will appear in the cloud on the mercy seat.
items.object: the cloud upon the mercy seat
items.mechanism: the divine presence in the cloud is the stated reason access is limited
